title: Support of a Subset Multi-Index
statement: For every $n\in\mathbb N$ and every subset $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, the support of the multi-index that takes value $1$ on $S$ and $0$ off $S$ is exactly $S$.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a finite subset of the coordinate set
